**MWNF Online Exhibition Platform**  
Under the patronage of the United Nations Alliance of Civilizations (UNAOC)  
  
We thank all our Partners who contributed to the exhibition for their support and cooperation.  
  
Furthermore, we thank the following Partners for having sponsored specific activities during the preparation phase:  
Ministry of Culture and Tourism of Türkiye  
Museum of Islamic Art Berlin  
  
**GENERAL CREDITS**  
  
Idea and overall concept: Eva Schubert  
Database: Pascal Havelange  
Application Programme Interface: Pascal Havelange  
Virtual Office: Preigo Fover Technologies  
Design: Eva Woo, Eva Schubert  
Front-end development: Eva Woo  
Content management: Sarah Hönigschnabel  
Content management *The Table Is Set*: Dounia Handis  
  
**EXHIBITION CREDITS  
  
A MWNF Online Exhibition  
THE TABLE IS SET: Food Traditions and Legacies in the Islamic World**  
  
**BACKGROUND**  
  
*The Table Is Set* project was inspired by the exhibition *Dining with the Sultan: The Fine Art of Feasting* organised by the Los Angeles County Museum of Art. The decision to set up an online exhibition around this topic was taken during a curatorial meeting in June 2023 in Doha. The meeting was hosted by our Partner, FBQ Museum, on the launch of the demo exhibition for the new MWNF online exhibition platform.  
  
**OVERALL CURATORIAL CONCEPT**  
  
We thank the following Partners for their contribution in defining the thematic structure of the exhibition:  
  
**Tunisia**, Tunis, Ministry of Cultural Affairs, National Institute of Heritage, Dr Sonia Mlayah Hamzaoui, Director of the Department of Inventory, Study of Ethnographic Properties and Contemporary Arts;  
**Egypt**, Cairo, Museum of Islamic Art, the curatorial team under the supervision of Dr Alaa El-Din Daoud, Deputy Director of Archaeological Affairs;  
**Qatar**, Doha, Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museum), Dr Terézia Anna Bardi, Director (until 06-2024); currently free-lance researcher and curator, Hungary;  
**Türkiye**, Ankara, Ministry of Culture and Tourism of Türkiye, Gülseher Gürgen, Museum Researcher at the Directorate General of Cultural Assets and Museums.  
  
**EXHIBITION TEAM  
  
Theme I: THE FOOD SYSTEM AT ISLAMIC COURTS**  
International Curatorial Coordinator: Dr Alaa El-Din Daoud, Museum of Islamic Art, Cairo  
Curatorial Assistant: Dr Ceren Soydan Katruff, Germany / Türkiye  
Curatorial and text contributions: Dounia Handis, Belgium;  
Ali M. Tarafdari, Iran; Fiza Ishaq, India  
  
**Theme II: SOCIAL LIFE**  
International Curatorial Coordinator: Dr Nael Chami, La Sapienza University, Rome, Italy  
Curatorial Assistant: Antonia Chela, South Africa (until 07-2024)  
Research contributions: Jana Zarkovic, Serbia  
  
**Theme III: RELIGION**  
International Curatorial Coordinator: Gülseher Gürgen, Ministry of Culture and Tourism, Türkiye  
Curatorial Assistant: Irem Gültepe, Türkiye  
  
**Theme IV: ENVIRONMENT**  
International Curatorial Coordinator: Dr Mehmet Kahyaoğlu, Yasar University, Izmir, Türkiye; currently Università L'Orientale, Naples, Italy  
Curatorial Assistant: Hassti Yekan, Iran, M.A.  
Research contributions: Claizza Regalado, Philippines  
  
**Theme V: GENDERED ROLES**  
International Curatorial Coordinator: Dina Turkieh, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates  
Curatorial Assistant: Nandi Furlani, Luxembourg, B.A.  
  
**Theme VI: COEXISTENCE**  
International Curatorial Coordinators: Dr Terézia Anna Bardi, Hungary; Dounia Handis, Belgium  
Curatorial Assistant: Stylianos Maratheftis, Cyprus, B.A.  
  
**About (overall Introduction), content editor, press texts**  
Dina Turkieh, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates  
  
**Cross-Thematic Assistant**  
Tayyebeh Babaei, Iran, M.A., currently pursuing her PhD at Trinity College Dublin and working part-time at Chester Beatty Library, Dublin, Ireland (specific focus on material from Iran)  
  
**Research Assistants**  
Fiza Ishaq, India  
Claizza Regalado, Philippines  
Jana Zarkovic, Serbia  
  
**Copy editors**  
Khuloud Al Blooshi, United Arab Emirates (content editor)  
Judy Harter, United States of America  
Alvaro Miranda, Puerto Rico  
  
**Marketing and International Online Press Conference**  
Recording of exhibition curator’s video statements &  
media contacts: Asha Trivedy, Edinburgh, United Kingdom  
Online press conference (Webinar hosting, technical coordination): Seidl+Seidl OG, Pottendorf, Austria  
  
The panel of speakers during the press conference was hosted at the Museum of Civilisations in Rome, with two speakers contributing from Bonn (Germany) and Amman (Jordan).  
  
We thank Ruth Checa, Spain, for a comprehensive final user experience test.
